review.method: static source/configuration review; CI validation; live Chromium/Playwright all-field attack matrix with test-only client input-shield bypass
review.limitations: Source review and CI evidence were inspected. A published-site Chromium/Playwright test (HTTP 200; CSP response header and meta policy present) used a temporary test-only bypass of the client input shield to exercise downstream handling. It passed 70 representative cases (58 configured attack-rule families and 12 semantic phrases) across 15 editable text fields: 1050 injections, no increase in risky DOM elements and no XSS canary execution. HTML/TXT/MD/CSV import, personal adhkar and tasbih rendering, share URL validation, password non-reflection, HTML export, and rejection of an invalid rescue file also passed. Direct raw DOM assignment briefly left five active markup constructs in the live editor, but CSP blocked inline script/event handlers and the save/reopen sanitizer removed them. This is not a comprehensive independent penetration test: no actual SQL/database, OS-command or SSRF requests were executed; PDF/Office/image imports, valid rescue restore replacement, mobile browser, all APIs and third-party integrations remain untested.

owner_reported_manual_xss_test.approaches: multiple manual XSS approaches; full payload list and per-case logs were not included in this review
owner_reported_manual_xss_test.result: No successful XSS execution was reported in the tested attempts. The input protection reportedly blocked suspicious terms and URLs before paste into fields and during typing.
owner_reported_manual_xss_test.scope_limit: This is a limited reported manual test, not a comprehensive penetration test or proof that all input, import, export, stored, reflected, and DOM XSS paths are safe.

live_editor_xss_smoke_test.environment: Chromium headless; Playwright 1.56.1; GitHub Actions Ubuntu 24.04
live_editor_xss_smoke_test.result: PASS: all 26 suspicious input attempts (13 samples via paste and typing) were blocked; no XSS canary fired and the benign Arabic writing control was accepted.
live_editor_xss_smoke_test.scope_limit: Limited to the published editor element #pg and the 13 listed probes. Does not prove all site inputs, stored/reflected/DOM rendering paths, file import/export, third-party content, or mobile browsers are safe. Not an independent comprehensive penetration test.

live_all_field_attack_matrix.environment: Chromium headless; Playwright 1.56.1; GitHub Actions Ubuntu 24.04
live_all_field_attack_matrix.bypass_scope: A temporary Chromium profile only; the test preloaded a matching version marker so Anwar Shield did not register input-blocking event handlers. No deployed code or user browser was changed.

imports.invalid_rescue_json: rejected; restore dialog remained closed and vault/note data unchanged

rendered_content.personal_adhkar: 8 of 8 samples rendered as text without active elements
rendered_content.custom_tasbih_dhikr: 4 of 4 samples rendered as text/options without active elements
rendered_content.share_url_protocol_validation: javascript: scheme rejected; only HTTP and HTTPS accepted
rendered_content.password_nonreflection: passed; values remained in password controls and were not reflected as markup
rendered_content.html_export: passed; title and body strings resembling markup remained inert text

direct_dom_editor_bypass.interpretation: Not a successful XSS execution. The live editor temporarily contained active markup when directly assigned through DOM, CSP blocked execution, and the sanitizer removed active markup after save/reopen. Immediate DOM sanitization is a recommended hardening improvement.

live_all_field_attack_matrix.scope_limit: 70 representative cases across 15 editable text fields (1050 field injections), not 1050 distinct attack types. SQLi, SSRF and command-injection inputs were tested as client-side detection strings only; no database, OS command or real SSRF request was executed. PDF/Office/image imports, valid rescue restore replacement, mobile browser, all API endpoints, all external integrations and independent comprehensive penetration testing were not covered.

encrypted_vault.webauthn_prf_device_unlock: optional; restricted in source to the approved HTTPS origin and supporting authenticators
